    All Classes and Interfaces

    Classes
    Class
    Description
    ArrayExample
    Demonstrates Java arrays containing object references and primitive values.
    ArrayListExample
    Demonstrates how an ArrayList stores and manages a collection of String objects.
    CircleType
    Represents a circle using its radius.
    CylinderType
    Represents a cylinder that inherits its radius and circle behavior from CircleType.
    OuterClass
    Demonstrates the difference between an inner class and a static nested class.
    Person
    Represents a person with a name and age.
    SphereType
    Represents a sphere that inherits its radius and basic behavior from CircleType.
    WrapperExample
    Demonstrates how the Integer wrapper class can be used with integer values and how a String can be converted into an int.
